description: Resize bb's text with a pinch: pinch over a terminal to change its font, or anywhere else to scale the app's text. App text scales from 75% to 200% and terminal text from 8 to 32px, and the terminal re-wraps to its new width when you let go. Works with a touchscreen, a trackpad pinch, or Ctrl and the mouse wheel. Sizes are saved on each device, and a Settings section has A−, A+ and Reset buttons. Terminal sizing hooks into bb's internal terminal component, so a bb update can break it until the plugin catches up; app text sizing does not depend on it.
